items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Yeah, that was a fellow named Lawrence Hall. He was a wonderful trumpet player too.

ctx.x: Did she approve of you taking up any?

Yeah, she wanted me to play piano but I always did like trombos. After I heard that fellow say cousin Lawrence, I don't forget his last name. I wanted to be like him. She came to Whirline one day to buy a book, you know, to play, to practice at home, practicing on the piano. And she asked to click for one of those books and he'd go give her a little second grade. She said I don't want that, I want 12th grade. I said you know you can't play no 12th grade music. So she just opened the book and said have your piano…
